rules: No off-platform contact details or requests to communicate outside the platform.
No requests for or offers of payment outside the platform.
No fabricated experience, credentials, clients or results.
No guarantees of outcomes (rankings, revenue, accuracy) that cannot be guaranteed.
No unpaid production work disguised as a test.
Automation must be human-supervised: every proposal and message is approved by the freelancer.
